svg.text: 2016 Audi S5 3.0T · Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.43 + ADS1115 · reuses the AWE sender, boost tap, hose, fume filter and BOTH AWE harnesses — no new cable runs
UNDER DASH — driver fuse panel (existing AWE)
2 Never connect USB-C to a PC while
the car 5 V is live (no diode).
3 Set the buck to 5.00 V on the bench
4 Sender stays nipple DOWN, filter kept.
5 Insulate the green constant-12 V lead.
6 Bench: sender on 12 V and 14.4 V must
read the same ~1.30 V (port open). If
Tag the sender harness before cutting
Dividers (1% resistors, built on the pod interface board)
battery voltage will come from OBD instead
Pin numbers: Waveshare schematic netlist — verify on the board. Sender harness: red 12 V, black GND, white signal (measured 2026-10-13).
